latest_release.body:
### Added
- Support edit xml files in /data/system
- Green highlight after modifying file
- Rename and edit last modified date in properties dialog
- Installer options
- Export smali/dex/jar in DEX Editor
- Badge for split apks and app data dirs
- Syntax in arsc editor
- Set default method with builtin methods (text editor, archive viewer, etc.)
- Folder animation option
- Add Thai translation by เดอะมิวส์ ฯ.
- Farsi translation by @Ahmad-Fardin
- Add subtitles in video player

### Changed
- Open the keyboard on dialog open (like rename, search etc.)
- Improve dex editor save speed
- Improve app opening speed
- Fill the search field with last search query in DEX, ARSC editor
- Collapsible sections in settings
- Show installer source in apk extractor
- Show last modified date on folders
- Show installed pack tools in a dedicated plugins section by @AuriSolCorues
- Bump minsdk to 23 & update dependencies
- APK Extractor:
  - Show more details in a dialog with apk, data path, signatures etc
  - More functions when multiple apps selected (uninstall, clear data, force stop, enable/disable)
  - Optimized loading of the apk extractor (fix displaying out of order)
- Change to 1 single share/view menu option with activity that calculates correct actions
  - Improved locate file from share/view menu
- Allow compare on 2 items in same pane
- Remove unnecessary packs and permissions
- Try support mtd translation
### Fixed
- Fix updating nested zips like apk in split apk
- Fix access some file like vendor/build.prop with shizuku
- Fix no background in text editor sidebar
- Fix some file show as folder with shizuku
- Fix some bad title outside of dialog
- Fix syntax highlighting
- AI Overview in DEX Editor
- Fix overlapping content in DEX Editor
- Fix .bak being modified
- Fix plugin options in apk dialog not working
- Fix natural sort files ending in number
- Fix next/prev buttons not working in media player
- Fix prompting for shizuku on android/data with root
- Fix crash on renaming files ending in .
- Try fix loading frameworks
- Try fix running in background
- Fix losing state on screen rotate
- Fix media player crash
- Fix EIO crash
- Fix change icon in quick edit
- Fix main 3 button menu click area
- Fix archive viewer not open at all on files with wrong extension
- Fix loading some folder in /data/data/../files
- Try to fix language selections only showing system default
